data.title: 紫藤伊莉娜 · 晨光白被单的祈愿微笑
data.description: 初升的金辉洒满纯白被褥，伊莉娜跪坐在大床中央。松散的睡衣滑落至腰际，纤巧的锁骨与腰身在晨光下勾勒出极其动人的优美线条。她双手合十闭上双眸做完清晨祈祷，随后睁开眼眸展颜欢笑，笑容比窗外的阳光还要耀眼明媚，向你道出最真挚的早安。
data.location: sun-drenched morning bedroom with white ruffled sheets
data.action: 她双手合十闭上双眸做完清晨祈祷，随后睁开眼眸展颜欢笑，笑容比窗外的阳光还要耀眼明媚
data.lighting: pure golden dawn rays piercing the bedroom window
data.promptProse: Bathed in golden early sunbeams streaming onto a white-sheeted bed, Irina kneels in the center of the mattress finishing a morning prayer before opening her eyes into a radiant, affectionate smile.
data.animaCaption: Kneeling across sunlit white bedsheets with her hands unfolding from a morning prayer, she beams warmly at the viewer with rosy cheeks as her gold-embroidered pure white silk camisole slips gently off her bare shoulders.
data.nsfwProse: Her pure white mulberry-silk camisole accented with delicate gold crest embroidery and a small cross pendant hangs loose off her bare shoulders and collarbones above matching tie-side sleep briefs.
